issues.reason: Thematic roles licenses a named role whenever the PP answers where/when/how/whence/whither and directs deciding by that question, Location's '(in/at/on ...)' gloss is illustrative rather than a closed list (the prompt's own reified postural takes a Location oblique for 'was lying across the threshold'), and only LocatedIn — the entity-side head — carries an explicit containment-only restriction, so (Location (sk_come $x) cold_sea) is licensed, true and well-typed.

new_gaps: the preposition boundary of the EVENT-side Location role: LocatedIn is legislated as containment-only with any other preposition kept entity-attached, but nothing states whether a non-containment locative/path preposition on an EVENT ('come over the sea', 'lay across the threshold') takes Location or the surface-preposition oblique (Over/Across <event> ...)
notes: Location is entailed by the storms coming over the sea, so it loses specificity but asserts nothing false — not the 'situated at rather than passing over' over-assertion the reviewer describes. The rest is correct: name symbol plus separate kind atom, noun-modifier genus withheld, non-volitional-force Patient, bare-generic rule at (STV 0.9 0.9) with no QuantifierPhrase.
